body.summary: Nadia Pell (Photography) reports that the Ashmere VPN connects in the office and the photo archive opens, but on the same laptop at home it stops at contacting gateway with no other error text. She needs the photo archive before Friday night photo close. The ticket is In Progress, priority High, category Network, with an empty resolution note. An internal note confirms the same office and home behavior on that laptop. It is not stated whether other internet access works at home when the VPN stops.

Hi Nadia,

We see that the Ashmere VPN connects in the office and the photo archive opens, but on the same laptop at home it stops at contacting gateway with no other error text. You need the photo archive before Friday night photo close.

Ashmere Press IT
